messages:
haley: Ran Albatross health scan — p95 jumping from 110ms -> 320ms during EU morning window; customer flagged renewal concern if we can't show latency plan :grimacing:
omar: Any breakdown? compute vs queueing vs region hot spots?
ben: Traces show two things: (1) EU ingress fanout causing cross-region hops; (2) high KV cache churn on long-lived sessions. They're on a single 30B fp16 endpoint in us-central with global traffic.
haley: Albatross asks for both cost relief and consistent latency. I'm proposing a "golden window" plan: during their EU business hours (08:00-18:00 CET) route priority traffic to a dedicated EU pool running an int8 variant; route lower-priority or burst traffic to a compact 4b hosted fallback. Outside golden window use pooled hosted endpoints with adaptive batching.
sara: Love it. Add adaptive model-mix: weight = f(queue_depth, recent_p95). If queue_depth>6 increase fallback fraction. Also enable sticky-session affinity for conversational sessions to preserve KV caches.
omar: ML notes: int8 build expected ~35% token-cost savings vs fp16, compact 4b fallback ~65% savings. int8 latency compute might be +15ms on short seqs, but p95 improves because queueing is reduced. 4b has higher regen risk — we should limit to non-priority intents.
ben: Operational checklist: create dedicated-eu pool with min_instances=3, enable KV-prefetch and prefix caching, set per-route timeout 2.1s, circuit-breaker failover after 1 retry. Instrument per-route metrics: p50/p95/p99, queue_depth, token_cost, regen_score.
haley: For quality guardrails, propose acceptance thresholds: regen-f1 drop <=1.5 pts, hallucination delta <=0.4%, user-flag rate <0.8% sustained. Rollback: any of the above exceeded for 30m.
sara: I'll prepare the eval suite focused on Albatross intents and add automated scoring. Also we'll run a synthetic load test to simulate EU morning surge before canary.
omar: Canary plan: 5% traffic to int8 (dedicated-eu) for 48h, 5% to compact-4b hosted fallback for burst traffic, with canary windows in 08:00-12:00 CET to capture peak behavior. If metrics stable for 24h, increment to 15% for another 24h.
ben: Snippet manifest for CS deck:
```json
{"golden_window":{"region":"eu","hours":"08:00-18:00 CET"},"canary":{"int8_percent":5,"compact4b_percent":5},"routes":[{"priority":"high","route":"dedicated-eu-int8"},{"priority":"low","route":"hosted-compact-4b"}],"timeouts":{"per_request_ms":2100},"circuit_breaker":{"retries":1}}
```
sara: Cost ballpark for CS: per-1M tokens baseline fp16 = $60k (example), int8 -> ~$39k (35% down), compact-4b fallback -> ~$21k (65% down) on fallback slices. We'll include ranges and stress that exact numbers depend on token mix.
haley: Scheduler-bot, please create ticket and calendar invite for customer handoff and internal rollout.
scheduler-bot: Created CS-11011 (Albatross golden-window canary). Calendar: Hand-off Tue 10:00 CET. Linked ML-EVAL-11011.
haley: Great — tagging @omar @ben @sara. Omar, can you drop the eval artifacts + A/B script by EOD? We'll send the proposal to Albatross and propose the first canary window next Thu 08:00-10:00 CET.
omar: On it. I'll include regen samples, evaluation notebook, and automated scoring thresholds.
haley: This should show a clear path to stabilize p95 and reduce unit cost before renewal. :pray:
